cases.title: Water consumption in FY 2025-26
cases.question: How much water was consumed in FY 2025-26, and how complete is that figure?
cases.source: Water p.1, 2321 consumed in the Dec 2025 billing period; the rest of the year has no bill

answer.question: How much water was consumed in FY 2025-26, and how complete is that figure?
answer.answer: The supported FY 2025-26 water consumption figure is 2321 Cubic Meters, entirely from the December 2025 bill for Coca-Cola Beverages India Pvt. Ltd. [E1][E2]. This covers only December 2025, i.e. 31 of 365 FY days or 8.5% of the financial year [C1], so the FY figure is incomplete. Months covered: Dec; months missing: Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Jan, Feb, Mar. No records were prorated, and no provided documents were outside FY 2025-26. The meter readings also reconcile to the same consumption: 14821 - 12500 = 2321 Cubic Meters [C2][E3].
